summary: The filing is an 8-K by Plains GP Holdings reporting second-quarter 2026 results. It includes a press release with financial highlights: net income of $1.830 billion, including a $1.6 billion gain from the divestiture of the Canadian NGL business, and Adjusted EBITDA of $738 million. The report also mentions the Cactus III acquisition synergies and increased 2026 organic growth capital. Although it references a completed divestiture, that transaction was previously disclosed and is not the subject of this filing. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special-situations event.
